description: Implementation of a Timer class for scheduling callbacks using epoll, timerfd, and threading in Android's scheduler component.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class that manages timers, dispatching callbacks at specified times using epoll and timerfd.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: A base class with a virtual destructor.

classes.name: TimeKeeper
classes.description: A base class with a virtual destructor.

methods.name: Timer::Timer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timer and starts the dispatch thread.

methods.name: Timer::~Timer
methods.description: Destructor that ends dispatch, joins the thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Timer::reset
methods.description: Resets the timer, creating timerfd and epoll, and optionally executes a callback if expected.

methods.name: Timer::cleanup
methods.description: Closes file descriptors and resets internal state.

methods.name: Timer::endDispatch
methods.description: Signals the dispatch loop to terminate.

methods.name: Timer::now
methods.description: Returns current system time in monotonic clock.

methods.name: Timer::alarmAt
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be invoked at a specific time.

methods.name: Timer::threadMain
methods.description: Main loop for dispatch thread, repeatedly calling dispatch.

methods.name: Timer::dispatch
methods.description: Handles epoll events, executing callbacks or terminating based on events.

methods.name: Timer::setDebugState
methods.description: Sets internal debug state with thread safety.

methods.name: Timer::dump
methods.description: Outputs current debug state to a string.
